exposure: Fetus genotype (GCK mutation vs non-GCK mutation)
cohort: The cohort comprised 257 GCK-MODY mothers and their 499 offspring, with 370 offspring further divided into GCK-affected and GCK-unaffected groups.
finding: The percentage of congenital malformations was 2.4% in offspring of GCK-MODY pregnant women, and newborns with the GCK mutation had lower birth complication rates compared to non-GCK mutation carriers.
